name: Earth warriors (Edgeville Dungeon)
accessNote: The Earth warriors occupy the north-eastern chamber of the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness levels 7-10), reached by crossing the monkey bars which require 15 Agility. Single-combat area; a cannon can be used and a safespot exists in the bottom-right corner or top of the first chamber. This is a PvP zone; bring risk-appropriate gear.
